purpose: Read and spontaneous prompts for the S8B-01 CP2 ASR benchmark. Every utterance is recorded by a consenting speaker of the stated dialect (bench-plan.json asr.corpus); the reference of a read prompt is its text as written; the reference of a spontaneous answer is the speaker's own verbatim transcript, written in their dialect's ordinary spelling. No user data, no real person's details: names, numbers and places are invented for the test.
